A '''''Darius G''-class freighter''' operated in [[Sector six (Castilon system)|sector six]]<ref name="Signal from Sector Six" /> by [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|1|7}}</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The freighter first appeared in "[[Signal from Sector Six]],"<ref name="Signal from Sector Six" /> the seventh episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series. The episode premiered on [[November 11]], [[2018]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
